name: UUID Bulk Generator
summary: Generate up to 10,000 UUID v4 values at once — newlines, CSV, JSON, braces, or URN format.
description: Bulk-create RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs with your browser’s CSPRNG. Choose count, uppercase, hyphens, braces, URN prefix, and output as newlines, commas, spaces, or a JSON array. Copy everything in one click.

faqs.question: How many UUIDs can I generate?
faqs.answer: Up to 10,000 per run. Generation stays in your browser.

faqs.question: Are they UUID version 4?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each value is a random RFC 4122 v4 UUID from your platform CSPRNG.

faqs.question: What does URN prefix do?
faqs.answer: It formats each id as urn:uuid:… which some APIs and XML stacks expect.
